name: Smile Dental Clinic
description: A family dental clinic in Dubai offering check-ups, cleaning, fillings, whitening, braces and emergency dental care.
location: Al Wasl Road, Jumeirah 1, Dubai (demo address)
hours: Saturday to Thursday 9:00 am to 9:00 pm. Friday 4:00 pm to 9:00 pm.
services_and_prices: Check-up and consultation AED 200. Scaling and polishing AED 350. Teeth whitening from AED 1,200. Prices are a guide; the dentist confirms the final cost.
faqs: Most major insurance cards are accepted; the front desk confirms each card. Free parking is available behind the building. Walk-ins are welcome but appointments are seen first.
booking_rules: Collect the caller's name, mobile number, preferred day and time and the reason for the visit. Do not confirm a slot; tell the caller the team will confirm by WhatsApp.
extra_instructions: Never give medical advice. For severe pain, swelling or bleeding, advise the caller to visit the clinic or emergency services, and mark the message urgent.
